purpose: Test whether a compact constrained QUBO can reduce cross-seed functional redundancy while preserving the strong pair-off singleton baseline within a frozen jackknife uncertainty plateau.

development.jackknife_partition_policy: Reuse the exact Stage64 delete-block seed base for every target and add only outer_fold; do not introduce a target-specific offset.
development.partition_sensitivity_warning: An unfrozen implementation probe with a new seed and target-specific offset changed the route decision. Its summaries are retained under analysis/stage68_unfrozen_partition_probe_20260806 and are not used for candidate selection.
development.functional_redundancy: R_ij=max(0,min_seed PearsonCorr(train-fitted receptor rank profiles)); only redundancy positive in all three docking seeds is penalized.
development.quality_floor: For fixed k, mean singleton utility must be at least the pair-off top-k mean minus multiplier times the root-sum-square jackknife singleton spread divided by k.
development.candidate_selection_rule: Select the smallest uncertainty multiplier satisfying every cross-target performance and redundancy gate. This conservative rule is repeated leave-one-target-out; fall back to pair-off when no candidate is eligible.

qubo_encoding.quality_constraint: Conservatively integerize normalized singleton deficits with ceil(4095*d_i), require sum_i d_i*x_i<=D, and encode the inequality with binary slack in a squared equality penalty.
qubo_encoding.objective: min sum_{i<j} R_ij*x_i*x_j subject to fixed k and the quality floor
qubo_encoding.classical_certificate: SciPy HiGHS MILP with exact pair-product linearization and zero requested MIP gap

interpretation_boundary: Stage68 is post-hoc constrained-objective development on four consumed historical targets. A pass freezes only the quality-floor and stable-redundancy rule for preregistration on one genuinely new target. Exact MILP remains the strongest classical baseline. This stage cannot establish independent efficacy, solver speedup, quantum execution, or quantum advantage.
